clock: seconds from Chat Run start to each subtask's verified completion
success: All assertions for the subtask pass and its completion time is <= budget_seconds; six equally weighted subtasks per valid run.
cumulative_latency: For the first k subtasks, max(t_1, ..., t_k); unknown or failed earlier subtasks make this cumulative time unknown.
delivery: Whole-run status and final delivery are recorded separately from subtask success.
over_budget: Continue to terminal; retain complete run latency and Agent plus OV LLM usage, including late and failed samples.
